versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section for direct entry points and onboarding guidance.
- Removed extra installation and automation references for clarity.
- No longer includes the file "skill-card.md"; only documentation remains.
- Content reorganized to improve navigation and quick access to essential APIDot resources.

- Added new reference notes file at references/api.md for local, non-executable API guidance.
- Updated SKILL.md to mention and describe references/api.md.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- No executable code, scripts, or network automation added or changed.

- Initial release provides documentation-only guidance for using the APIDot Kling 2.6 API.
- Covers workflows for text-to-video, image-to-video, native audio video generation, async job handling, polling, and webhooks.
- Includes security best practices for managing APIDot API keys.
- Directs users to official APIDot documentation, model pages, and example resources.
- No executable code or network calls included in this version—only documentation in SKILL.md.
